context: Scene D r32: W1 restructured around newly-found real execution evidence. A full-timeline frame-accurate scan + vision pass of ae-decompose-ops.mp4 (all 1488 frames sampled) found a genuine script-execution dialog at source f161-190 (t6.7-7.9s): title 'Executing Script c75ad44e-…', message 'Script execution time 0 minutes 4 seconds', Cancel button — appearing while the ty-plus panel with Decompose/Merge/Refine buttons is open on the master comp. REC source and REC decomposed comps containing STROKE_### layers appear later in the same recording, so this script run IS the decompose operation's trigger. W1 now uses two clips: clip A (source t6.4-8.0) shows the dialog = execution evidence, with a dedicated ~0.75x PiP making 'Executing Script' + Cancel readable; clip B (source t35.9-38.0) jump-cuts to the REC decomposed comp where single 'Restro' holds then the verified f886 swap lands decomposed strokes (~PV343) with ~27f result hold. The Restro panel PiP (Decompose/Merge/Refine, ~1.2x) persists across both clips identifying the plugin; a comp-header PiP restricted to clip B shows the comp literally named 'REC decomposed'. The same full scan verified NO mouse click or button press-state exists anywhere in any of the three recordings (cursor appears but never over the Restro buttons; no pressed state), so the scene claims script execution -> result, never a click. W2 (two-clip stepped jumps), W3 (adjustment clips), W4 (reprocess arc with its own Executing dialog + Restro/MV result) are unchanged from r30. Left copy, captions, window positions and scene boundaries unchanged.
